description: This file contains the implementation of the SerializationEntryCodec class, which handles serialization and deserialization of SerializationEntrySurrogate objects within the Orleans.Serialization framework.

classes.name: SerializationEntryCodec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IFieldCodec for SerializationEntrySurrogate objects, providing methods for writing to and reading from a serialization stream.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a SerializationEntrySurrogate object into a binary format using the provided writer and field information.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a SerializationEntrySurrogate object from a binary stream, reconstructing it based on the read field headers.
